The Calendar raw-event mismatch (`retainsCalendarEventSource` versus mixin `retainsRawCalendarEvent`) makes the read dialog dereference an absent `event.calendar`; it predates target positioning/draft commits in the inspected stacks and is not alone proof of their causality. [Task 1]
